h: Blinkit Ambulance will now charge ₹2,500 for non-emergency trips
k: Emergency rides stay free. Routine trips like check-ups and hospital-to-home transfers will now be paid.

h: Deepinder Goyal hits back at doctors over his ‘Temple’ wearable
k: Doctors called the ₹85,000 brain-tracking gadget a scam. Goyal says the science will prove them wrong.

h: A viral video got a PVR juice counter shut in Bengaluru
k: A moviegoer alleged that used cups were being reused. Food safety officials inspected — and shut the counter.

h: India set for a ₹1 lakh crore Dhanteras
k: Traders expect record shopping today — led by gold and silver, even though gold is about 20% costlier than last year.

h: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football
k: After 23 years and a record 146 goals, the 41-year-old is done playing for Portugal — but he isn't leaving Al-Nassr.

h: Wall Street loses $2.5 trillion in a single day
k: The Nasdaq fell 5.5%, its worst day since April 2025, as AI and chip stocks crashed.

h: Tankers catch fire in the Strait of Hormuz
k: Iran says at least five tankers and a tugboat caught fire, several after hitting mines. Oil crossed $100 a barrel.

h: 40 US towns vote NO to AI data centers
k: Voters rejected new data-center projects, angry about power bills and pollution.

h: Airtel's profit jumps 24% as users pay more
k: Bharti Airtel's quarterly profit rose to ₹10,710 crore, helped by higher revenue per user.
India's biggest insurer had a strong September quarter, though new first-year premiums dipped slightly.

h: TRAI proposes separate licences for satellite internet
k: The telecom regulator wants satellite players under a new set of rules — and not selling directly to customers.

h: Deepti Sharma in the race for ICC Player of the Month
k: The all-rounder was shortlisted after a match-winning show against Zimbabwe.
